channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Leitrim GAA saddened at young teacher's untimely passing
item.description: Leitrim GAA has paid a heartfelt tribute to a young Manorhamilton woman and teacher who died earlier this week.

item.title: 'I just want to be playing games'
item.description: John McGrath doesn't intent taking too long of a break after a long season with club and county.

item.title: Another day, another Westmeath hurler retires
item.description: Robbie Greville has become the third Westmeath hurler to announce his inter-county retirement in a fortnight.

item.title: 2026 Dr McKenna Cup draw made
item.description: The draw has taken place for the 2026 Dr McKenna Cup.

item.title: 'I will never look at it again'
item.description: Patrick Horgan doubts if he will ever be able to watch a rerun of this year's All-Ireland SHC final.

item.title: Savage named as new LGFA Chief Executive Officer
item.description: Lyn Savage has been confirmed as the new Chief Executive Officer of the Ladies Gaelic Football Association.

item.title: Ulster SFC draw: Armagh and Tyrone meet in preliminary round
item.description: A heavy hitting Ulster SFC draw has put Armagh, Tyrone, Donegal and Down one side of the competition.

item.title: Munster SFC draw: Cork and Kerry kept apart
item.description: A traditional Kerry v Cork Munster SFC is a possibility after the two counties were put on opposite sides of the provincial championship.

item.title: Connacht SFC draw: Roscommon and Mayo paired on one side
item.description: Mayo and Roscommon could meet in a provincial semi-final after the Connacht SFC draw took place this evening.

item.title: Leinster SFC draw: Brennan's Dublin on course to meet Louth
item.description: Leinster champions Louth could meet their old manager Ger Brennan should their progress to the provincial semi-finals.
